readme:
This interface embodies the convergence of quantum computing power and institutional finance excellence. Every pixel communicates precision, authority, and cutting-edge technology. The design language draws from quantum physics visualization (wave functions, probability clouds, superposition states) while maintaining the gravitas expected in private banking and institutional investment environments. This is where trillion-dollar decisions meet quantum-speed computation.

**Blend:** Quantum Computing 55% + Private Banking 30% + Scientific Precision 15%  
**Temperature:** 3/10 (cool) · **Formality:** 10/10 · **Tags:** tech, premium, professional  
**Perfect for:** Quantum Finance, Algorithmic Trading, Scientific Investment

## Content fundamentals

- Write for members and staff of the organization: direct, formal and composed.
- Headings name the thing plainly: “QUANTUM COMPUTING INVESTMENT PLATFORM”, “INVESTMENT STRATEGIES”, “Multi-Asset Superposition”, “Institutional Fixed Income”.
- Buttons are short verb phrases in Title Case: “◆ Execute Quantum Analysis”, “⟨ψ⟩ Run Simulation”, “Reset Parameters”.
- Navigation uses single nouns: “Portfolio”, “Analytics”, “Trading”, “Research”.
- The reference page uses emoji as inline glyphs (⚡ ⚠ ©); keep them functional, never decorative.

## Color

- Set the page on `page-bg` with body text in `page-text`. The theme is light.
- Identity colours: `color-quantum-purple`, `color-finance-gold`, `color-deep-navy`, `color-silver-light`. Lead with the first; use the rest for accents and emphasis.
- Status colours (`badge-error-bg`) always travel with a word or icon; never signal state by hue alone.
- Each token's note says where the reference page uses it and, for text colours, its contrast on `page-bg`. Keep body text at 4.5:1 or better.

### Palette rationale

- Quantum Purple (#5b21b6): Deep violet representing quantum states, computational
- power, advanced technology, innovation leadership, mysterious sophistication
- Finance Gold (#d4af37): Old money elegance, institutional wealth, trusted authority,
- precious metal stability, executive luxury, investment prestige
- Deep Navy (#0c0f25): Profound depth, institutional trust, financial security,
- executive gravitas, night sky of possibilities, conservative stability
- Precision Silver (#94a3b8): Metallic accuracy, technological precision, data integrity,
- computational clarity, refined neutrality, professional objectivity
- Quantum Teal (#0ea5e9): Active computation, live data streams, dynamic analysis,
- real-time processing, liquid assets, flowing capital
- Pure White (#ffffff): Absolute clarity, pristine data, perfect precision, institutional
- cleanliness, uncompromising standards

## Typography

- `display` — "IBM Plex Serif", Georgia, serif
- `ibm-plex-mono` — "IBM Plex Mono", monospace

Faces are hosted on Google Fonts (IBM Plex Serif, IBM Plex Mono); load them with:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Serif:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap">
```

- Set titles in `display`, sections in `heading-2` and running text in `body`.
- Uppercase is reserved for small labels (`label`), always with the letter-spacing given.

### Type rationale

- IBM Plex Serif (Headings & Display):
- Authoritative serif suggesting institutional gravitas
- Academic and financial heritage
- Readable at large sizes for executive summaries
- Professional credibility with technical precision
- Weight variations (300-700) for hierarchy
- Excellent for financial statements and reports

- IBM Plex Mono (Data & Numbers):
- Monospace for perfect numerical alignment
- Scientific calculator precision
- Code-like appearance for algorithms
- Tabular data readability
- Financial ticker aesthetic
- Quantum computation readout style

## Spacing, shape and elevation

- Spacing steps: `spacing-xs` 8px, `spacing-sm` 16px, `spacing-md` 24px, `spacing-lg` 48px, `spacing-xl` 96px. Pad cards and sections from these steps only.
- Corners: `radius-sm` 4px, `radius-md` 8px, `radius-lg` 16px.
- Elevation: `shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`, `shadow-lg`, `shadow-quantum`, lowest first for resting cards, higher for hover and overlays.

1. Executive Header: Quantum wave gradient with institutional branding
2. Portfolio Metrics: High-precision financial indicators with quantum effects
3. Investment Cards: Premium asset allocation displays with waveform backgrounds
4. Transaction Ledger: Institutional-grade data table with quantum highlights
5. Analysis Dashboard: Computational forms with quantum-secure inputs
6. Action Controls: High-value transaction buttons with security states
7. Status Indicators: Quantum state badges showing processing levels
8. Institutional Footer: Regulatory compliance and prestige links

## States and motion

- Quantum wave animations on hover suggesting superposition
- Precision highlighting for high-stakes data
- Smooth transitions reflecting institutional confidence
- Security-conscious feedback on actions
- Subtle gradients indicating live processing
- Professional restraint in all animations
- Executive-level interaction patterns

Timing values: `--transition-fast` 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), `--transition-base` 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), `--transition-slow` 500ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1).

- Honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: drop lifts and transitions to instant state changes.

## Iconography

- The reference page uses no icon set; when icons are needed, use a single-weight line set at text size in `currentColor`.
- No logo ships with this style: set the organization name in the `display` style.

## Accessibility

- `page-text` on `page-bg` measures 17.3:1.
- Every interactive element shows a visible focus state at 3:1 or better against its surface.
- Measured on `page-bg`, these text colours fall short of 4.5:1: `color-finance-gold` 1.9:1, `color-precision-silver` 2.3:1, `color-silver-light` 1.4:1, `color-quantum-teal` 2.5:1, `color-pure-white` 1.1:1, `badge-error-bg` 4.4:1. Use them only for large text (24px+) or on the fills their notes name, whatever the design notes below claim.

From the style's design notes (ratios checked against the tokens; a **bold** measurement replaces a claim that does not hold):

- WCAG 2.1 AAA compliance for financial data
- 7:1 contrast ratio for all critical numbers
- 4.5:1 minimum for body text
- Semantic HTML for screen readers
- ARIA labels on all financial data
- Keyboard navigation for traders
- Focus indicators with 3px borders
- Color-independent data visualization
- Sufficient 44x44px touch targets
- Dyslexia-friendly IBM Plex fonts

## Component inventory

The reference page composes these patterns from the tokens above:

1. Executive Header: Quantum wave gradient with institutional branding
2. Portfolio Metrics: High-precision financial indicators with quantum effects
3. Investment Cards: Premium asset allocation displays with waveform backgrounds
4. Transaction Ledger: Institutional-grade data table with quantum highlights
5. Analysis Dashboard: Computational forms with quantum-secure inputs
6. Action Controls: High-value transaction buttons with security states
7. Status Indicators: Quantum state badges showing processing levels
8. Institutional Footer: Regulatory compliance and prestige links

## Further guidance

### Spatial Hierarchy

- 16px base unit for mathematical precision
- 8px micro-spacing for data density
- 24px standard spacing for content separation
- 48px major spacing for section breaks
- 96px executive spacing for dramatic emphasis
- Golden ratio (1.618) in card proportions
- Fibonacci sequence for nested hierarchies

### Emotional Temperature

- Cold Sophisticated (3/10):
- Calculated, not impulsive
- Cerebral rather than emotional
- Professional distance maintained
- Scientific objectivity preserved
- Cool quantum physics aesthetic
- Institutional restraint throughout
- Precision over personality

### Formality Level

- Maximum Institutional (10/10):
- White-glove private banking service
- C-suite executive expectation
- Regulatory compliance visual language
- Fiduciary responsibility communication
- Institutional investor standards
- Swiss bank vault precision
- Family office sophistication

### Performance Optimization

- CSS gradients instead of images
- Hardware-accelerated transforms
- Efficient pseudo-element patterns
- Minimal repaints during updates
- Optimized Google Fonts loading
- CSS custom properties for theming
- Will-change hints for animations
- Layer promotion for smooth scrolling

### Brand Alignment

- Establishes quantum-age financial leadership through:
- Cutting-edge technology visualization
- Institutional banking heritage
- Scientific precision standards
- Executive-level presentation
- Fiduciary trust signals
- Innovation credibility

### Use Cases

- Institutional investment platforms
- Quantum computing financial services
- Private banking portals
- High-frequency trading dashboards
- Wealth management systems
- Hedge fund analytics
- Central bank interfaces
- Sovereign wealth fund management

### Competitive Differentiation

- Unlike standard financial interfaces, this design:
- Visualizes quantum computing advantage
- Balances innovation with institutional trust
- Communicates precision at quantum scale
- Signals next-generation capabilities
- Maintains regulatory gravitas
- Projects technological leadership

### Scalability

- Component system supports:
- Multi-currency displays
- Real-time quantum calculations
- Portfolio complexity scaling
- Regulatory framework variations
- White-label customization
- Responsive across devices
